transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I just don’t really want to do much anymore. Stuff I used to look forward to—salsa nights, church things, cooking for neighbors. Even going into my shop, smelling the wood… it just doesn’t pull me in like it used to.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… most days. Especially in the mornings. I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, and I’m just trying to hold it together so my wife doesn’t see me fall apart.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like salsa nights, church events, or cooking for neighbors?

Yeah. I’ve kind of stopped wanting to do all of that… salsa, church gatherings, cooking for folks. Even going into the shop doesn’t feel the same anymore, and that used to be something I could count on.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… six months, I think. It’s been long enough that it doesn’t feel like just a rough week anymore.
Have you had a depressed mood most of the day, more days than not, for at least two years?
I don’t think it’s been two years. I mean… I’ve had rough stretches before, but this… this has been more like the last several months.
Have you felt a lack of energy or felt fatigued almost every day during this time?

Yeah… pretty much every day. Even if I sit down or get a full night in bed, I still feel worn out—like I’ve been framing a roof all day. Little stuff, like loading tools into the truck, feels like too much.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating a lot less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?
I haven’t really noticed anything big there. My appetite’s maybe been a little off here and there, but… I don’t think my weight’s changed much.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or feeling restless and unable to sit still almost every day?
Yeah… some. Guys at work have said I’m either moving real slow, like I can’t get myself going, or I’m just pacing around the shop rubbing my hands and not getting much done.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much, or blaming yourself for things more than usual, almost every day?

Yeah… I guess so. I keep going back over every appointment, every little change with my wife’s health, and thinking… if I’d been a better husband, maybe I would’ve caught something sooner. Protected her somehow. It’s hard not to blame myself.
Have you ever experienced periods like this before, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble functioning?
I don’t know… maybe. I’ve had rough patches before, sure, but I don’t really know if they were like this. I usually just tried to keep working and not think too much about it.
Have you ever had a period in the past when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time?
Yeah… this one’s been going on a while. I’d say maybe six months now. It doesn’t feel like just a bad couple weeks anymore.
Have you been through any major stress or life changes recently, like a loss, conflict, or something else that's been really hard on you?
Yeah… my wife’s health took a sudden turn a couple months ago. Since then everything at home changed, the routine and all that. That’s about when I started feeling… different.
Have you had periods of depression that lasted for two years or longer in the past?
I don’t think so… not two years. I’ve had bad stretches, but I can’t say they went on that long.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling down or losing interest in things in your life?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had rough times before, yeah, but I don’t know if I’d call them separate episodes.
Have you ever had another time in your life, before this current period, when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time?
I don’t really know. Maybe I’ve had times where I was pretty low, but… more than two weeks, before this? I can’t say for sure.
Have you ever had a time in your life, before this current period, when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, even if it didn’t last as long as this one?
I’m not sure. I’ve had times where I wasn’t doing great, but I don’t really remember if it was more than two weeks or just… a rough patch.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks but less than two years?
I really don’t know. I mean, I’ve had bad stretches before, but I can’t pin down whether it was over two weeks or how long it lasted.
Before this current period, have you had any episodes where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks but not as long as two years?
I don’t know, honestly. I’ve had rough times, yeah, but I can’t say for sure they were over two weeks or under two years. I just don’t really track it like that.
Before this current period, have you had any distinct times when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks but not as long as two years?
I still can’t really say. I know I’ve had times I wasn’t myself, but whether it was that exact kind of stretch… more than two weeks and less than two years… I don’t know.
Before this current period, have you had any distinct episodes where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time?
I can’t really tell. I’ve had times where I felt off or down, but I don’t know that I can call them distinct episodes or say they lasted more than two weeks.
